findings.title: Published population rose by 2,036
findings.method: Sum all 35 groups per date and subtract August from September.
findings.limitation: Registered/biometrically identified population snapshots; changes do not identify migration, births or registration effects.

findings.title: Camp 4 Extension has the largest percentage increase
findings.observation: Camp 4 Extension: 11,705 → 12,070 people (+365; +3.118%). Largest absolute and percentage increase among 35 matched groups.
findings.method: (September / August − 1) × 100 for each of 35 matched groups.
findings.limitation: Count changes only; geographic definitions and field mechanisms need verification.

findings.title: Water and sanitation remain below annual targets at H1
findings.observation: Published target attainment: water 49%, sanitation 53%; separate WASH funding status 67%.
findings.method: Read page 1 UNICEF response chart. Shortfall to annual target is 51 and 47 percentage points.
findings.limitation: Mid-year annual-target progress is not evidence of being behind schedule; no planned H1 trajectory. Funding is a distinct measure.
